command: $s2bReviewProcesses = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(vitis|vivado|hw_server|cs_server|xsdb|xelab|xsim|arm-none-eabi).*' -and $_.Name -notmatch '^vivado-mcp-server' } | Select-Object Name,ProcessId,ParentProcessId); @{checked_at=(Get-Date).ToString('o');heavy_processes=$s2bReviewProcesses;memory=(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object TotalVisibleMemorySize,FreePhysicalMemory)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
scope: 仅查进程/资源；未关闭其他会话，本轮不运行重型构建。
